pages.excerpt:
The**prime minister of Malta**([Maltese](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Maltese_language):*Prim Ministru ta' Malta*) is the[head of government](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Head_of_Government), which is the highest official of[Malta](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malta). The prime minister chairs[Cabinet](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cabinet_of_Malta)meetings, and selects its ministers to serve in their respective portfolios. The prime minister holds office by their ability to command the confidence of the[Parliament](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parliament_of_Malta), as such they sit as[members of Parliament](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Parliament_of_Malta).
